summary: Master ALM, ESG integration, and fiduciary governance in our 5-day Advanced Pension Fund Management course. Optimize solvency and investment strategy today.
lede: Retirement fund management covers aligning investment portfolios with future benefit payments while monitoring solvency and risk. For investment, actuarial, governance and portfolio professionals responsible for retirement funds, it builds practical capability in liability modeling, strategic asset allocation, stress testing, and communicating performance and risk to trustees.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the financial health and governance of retirement schemes.
modules: Strategic Asset Allocation and Portfolio Construction
ESG Integration and Sustainable Pension Investing
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in finance, investment management, or actuarial services. A basic understanding of financial markets, interest rate mechanics, and standard accounting principles is required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with spreadsheet-based financial modeling is highly recommended.
